market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR are the defending 2024 champions and a consistently strong IPL franchise; even a baseline 1-in-10 chance gives 10%, while the market implies only 2%. That divergence is too extreme to ignore, even accounting for long-term uncertainty.
evidence_points: KKR won the 2024 Indian Premier League title.
A naive 1-in-10 probability for any among the ten teams equals 10%.
Historically, strong IPL teams typically have at least a 5–8% chance in any single season.
